name: OneDrive Sync
description: Sync selected OneDrive folders into the Cortex knowledge graph — on demand or on a schedule, fully server-side via Microsoft Graph delta

config.name: ENTRA_CLIENT_ID
config.description: Application (client) ID of a Microsoft Entra app registration (free at entra.microsoft.com). Supported account types must include personal Microsoft accounts, and 'Allow public client flows' must be enabled - device-code flow, no client secret needed anywhere.
